Observed local exposure/source fact: Drift comparison uses a 3-entry history that the sync thread also refreshes every second, so it spans only a few seconds, not a long-term or original setpoint
Potential simulated process impact: A slow ramp (for example +1.0 bar every 2 s, about 1.5 bar per three entries) would be expected to stay under the 2.0 bar drift threshold and be stopped only by the absolute range
Likelihood: Medium (derived from source; not demonstrated, SV-03 was contained by the range check)

Detective control: Periodically compare current accepted value against a long-term logged baseline
